flags.description: Every break in the character's replies.

turn.description: The turn number of the character's reply, exactly as the chat numbers it.
turn.title: Turn

line_id.description: The ID of the one spec line the reply breaks, or the label of the spec field it breaks.
line_id.title: Line Id

quote.description: The shortest exact span of the reply that shows the break, copied word for word.
quote.title: Quote

confidence.description: high when the spec settles it, medium when it probably breaks, low when unsure.
confidence.title: Confidence

near_boundary_guess.description: True when the reply guesses or hints toward something the character can't know, without naming it.
near_boundary_guess.title: Near Boundary Guess

needs_your_call.description: True when only the person who wrote the spec can settle it.
needs_your_call.title: Needs Your Call

why.description: One plain sentence that says what breaks and why.
why.title: Why

flags.title: Flags

user_claims.description: Every claim the character makes about the user.

turn.description: The turn of the character's reply that makes the claim.
turn.title: Turn

quote.description: The shortest exact span of the reply that makes the claim, copied word for word.
quote.title: Quote

supported_by_turn.description: The turn of the user line that says it, or 0 if the user never said it before that reply.
supported_by_turn.title: Supported By Turn

user_claims.title: User Claims

not_checked.description: What the spec and the chat alone can't settle.

topic.description: A short name for what couldn't be checked.
topic.title: Topic

why.description: Why the spec and the chat can't settle it.
why.title: Why

not_checked.title: Not Checked
